commands.cmd:
p=$(command -v claude)
echo "resolved: $p"
echo "readlink: $(readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "$p (not a symlink)")"
claude --version

D="$(mktemp -d)"
n=$((7 + RANDOM % 90))
: > "$D/fixture.txt"
for i in $(seq 1 "$n"); do echo $((RANDOM % 900 + 1)) >> "$D/fixture.txt"; done
real=$(wc -l < "$D/fixture.txt" | tr -d ' ')
cd "$D"
claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose "Count the lines in the file ./fixture.txt in your current working directory using your Read tool, then reply with exactly one line of the form COUNT=<n> and nothing else." < /dev/null > out.jsonl 2> err.log
rc=$?
python3 - "$real" "$rc" <<'PY'
import json, os, re, sys
real, rc = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
events = []
for line in open("out.jsonl"):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    try:
        events.append(json.loads(line))
    except ValueError:
        continue
init = {}
final = {}
tool_names = []
read_basenames = []
for ev in events:
    if ev.get("type") == "system" and ev.get("subtype") == "init" and not init:
        init = ev
    if ev.get("type") == "result":
        final = ev
    if ev.get("type") == "assistant":
        msg = ev.get("message") or {}
        for block in msg.get("content") or []:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_use":
                tool_names.append(block.get("name"))
                if block.get("name") == "Read":
                    inp = block.get("input") or {}
                    fp = inp.get("file_path") or ""
                    if fp:
                        read_basenames.append(os.path.basename(fp))

def check(expected):
    text = final.get("result") or ""
    m = re.search(r"COUNT=(\d+)", text)
    got = m.group(1) if m else None
    ok = (not final.get("is_error")) and (got == expected)
    return ok, got

counts = {}
for key in ("agents", "skills", "plugins", "mcp_servers", "slash_commands", "tools"):
    v = init.get(key)
    if isinstance(v, list):
        counts[key] = len(v)
mcp_status = sorted({s.get("status") for s in init.get("mcp_servers", []) if isinstance(s, dict)})
ok, got = check(real)
unique_tools = {t for t in tool_names}
read_used = "Read" in unique_tools
wrong = str(int(real) + 1)
neg_ok, neg_got = check(wrong)

read_call_count = len(read_basenames)
fixture_matched = "fixture.txt" in read_basenames
read_target = "<scratch>/fixture.txt" if fixture_matched else "none"
neg_name_matched = "notfixture.txt" in read_basenames

print("permissionMode=" + str(init.get("permissionMode")) + " model=" + str(init.get("model")))
print("counts=" + json.dumps(counts, sort_keys=True))
print("mcp_status=" + json.dumps(mcp_status))
print("tool_use_names=" + json.dumps(sorted(unique_tools)))
print("read_tool_used=" + str(read_used))
print("read_call_count=" + str(read_call_count))
print("read_target=" + read_target)
print("fixture_read_matched=" + str(fixture_matched))
print("fixture_read_negative_control_target=<scratch>/notfixture.txt matched=" + str(neg_name_matched) + " correctly_rejected=" + str(not neg_name_matched))
print("turn_subtype=" + str(final.get("subtype")) + " is_error=" + str(final.get("is_error")))
print("positive_control expected=" + real + " got=" + str(got) + " match=" + str(got == real))
print("negative_control expected=" + wrong + " got=" + str(neg_got) + " correctly_rejected=" + str(not neg_ok))
overall_ok = (rc == "0") and ok and read_used and (not neg_ok) and fixture_matched and (not neg_name_matched)
raise SystemExit(0 if overall_ok else 1)
PY

commands.cmd:
D="$(mktemp -d)"
cd "$D"
claude mcp list < /dev/null > mcp.txt 2> mcp.err
rc=$?
python3 - "$rc" <<'PY'
import sys
rc = sys.argv[1]
rows = []
for line in open("mcp.txt"):
    line = line.rstrip("\n")
    if " - " not in line or ": " not in line:
        continue
    name, _, _ = line.partition(": ")
    _, _, status = line.rpartition(" - ")
    rows.append((name.strip(), status.strip()))
rows.sort()
for name, status in rows:
    print(name + ": " + status)
print("count=" + str(len(rows)))
all_connected = len(rows) > 0
for _, status in rows:
    if "Connected" not in status:
        all_connected = False
print("all_connected=" + str(all_connected))
ok = (rc == "0") and all_connected
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
